text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about bias. If the data used to train AI is not fair, the results can unfairly harm certain groups of people. Fairness means treating everyone equally, no matter who they are. Privacy is also a major concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should be transparent about how their systems work and what data they use. Finally, responsible AI development means developers, governments, and users must work together to make sure AI helps society without causing harm.
